description: This file defines the 'TimesheetEntriesParamRule' class, which extends an abstract validation rule to validate entries related to timesheet submissions. It includes logic for handling date and time validation, project and activity IDs, and integrity checks against existing timesheet data.

classes.name: TimesheetEntriesParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class for validating timesheet entry parameters, including project IDs, activity IDs, dates, and durations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a specific timesheet ID.

methods.name: getApiDateRule
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of ApiDate used for date validation.

methods.name: getTimeRule
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of Time for duration format validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on an array of entry data, checking for required fields, date ranges, durations, and consistency with existing timesheet data.
